title: Engine noise inspection – 2022 Mustang
content: Customer reports rattling noise from engine during cold start and acceleration. Road test confirmed audible rattle from the front of the engine between 1500 and 3000 RPM. Stethoscope indicates noise originating near the timing cover area. No diagnostic trouble codes stored. Oil level and condition normal. Suspect timing chain tensioner wear.

title: Front brake inspection – 2023 F-150
content: Customer reports squealing noise from front wheels when braking at low speed. Measured front brake pad thickness: 1.2mm remaining on both inner pads (minimum specification 2.0mm). Outer pads at 3.1mm. Rotors show minor scoring, measured within resurfacing tolerance. No ABS fault codes.
repair_outcome: Pads replaced, rotors resurfaced. Noise eliminated.

title: Cooling system diagnosis – 2021 Explorer
content: Customer reports engine overheating after 20 minutes of highway driving. Cooling system pressure test held at 16 PSI for 15 minutes, no external leaks found. Thermostat opens at 195F within specification. Water pump removed for inspection: impeller blades show significant cavitation damage and reduced flow capacity. Recommend water pump replacement.
repair_outcome: Water pump replaced. Cooling system refilled and bled. Temperature stable.

title: Charging system diagnosis – 2024 Escape
content: Customer reports battery warning light and dimming headlights under load. Battery load test passed (680 CCA measured, 650 CCA required). Alternator output at idle: 13.8V no load, drops to 11.2V with A/C and headlights on (minimum specification 13.5V). Internal voltage regulator failure confirmed. Alternator replacement required.

title: HVAC diagnosis – 2020 Edge
content: Customer reports warm air from driver side vents while passenger side blows cold. Dual-zone climate control settings verified correct. Audible clicking noise behind driver-side dashboard near the blend door location. Blend door actuator not responding to temperature changes. Actuator motor draws no current when commanded.

title: Suspension noise inspection – 2023 Bronco
content: Customer reports clunking noise over bumps from front suspension. Visual inspection reveals cracked rubber bushings on both front stabilizer bar end links. Vertical play detected when prying end links manually. No other suspension components show wear. Recommend end link replacement on both sides.

title: Transmission shift quality diagnosis – 2022 Ranger
content: Customer reports hesitation and jerk on the 2-3 upshift under light throttle. Transmission fluid level and condition within specification. Adaptive shift strategy reset performed but shift quality did not improve after 50-mile relearn drive. Scan tool data shows delayed 2-3 shift engagement by approximately 400ms. Suspect valve body solenoid pack malfunction affecting shift timing.

title: Engine noise inspection – 2021 Mustang GT
content: Customer reports rattling noise at idle and low-speed acceleration. Noise appears to originate from the front of the engine near the timing cover. No diagnostic trouble codes present. Oil pressure within specification. Timing chain stretch suspected based on noise character and mileage. Recommend timing chain kit replacement including guides and tensioner.

title: Historical engine rattle repair – 2020 Mustang
content: 2020 Mustang EcoBoost with 52,000 miles. Customer complained of engine rattling during acceleration. Root cause identified as timing chain tensioner failure. Timing chain, tensioner and guides replaced. Total parts cost $900. Labour 12 hours. Noise eliminated after repair. Verified by road test.
repair_outcome: Timing chain tensioner replaced. Noise resolved.

title: Historical timing chain repair – 2019 Mustang GT
content: 2019 Mustang GT 5.0L V8 with 60,000 miles. Similar rattling noise at idle. Timing chain replacement performed including guides and tensioner. Parts cost $1,750. Labour 18 hours. Post-repair inspection confirmed noise eliminated.
repair_outcome: Timing chain kit replaced. Noise resolved.

title: Timing chain kit pricing reference
content: Ford timing chain kit BR3Z-6268-A. Includes timing chain, tensioner, and chain guides. List price $1,650. Dealer cost approximately $1,200. Typical labour time per Ford workshop manual: 16-20 hours depending on engine variant.

title: Brake pad and rotor service labour guide
content: Front brake pad replacement with rotor resurfacing. Standard labour time: 1.5-2.5 hours. If rotor replacement is required instead of resurfacing, add 0.5 hours per side. Rear brake pad replacement: 1.5-2.0 hours.

title: Front brake pad thickness inspection procedure
content: Measure brake pad thickness at the thinnest point on each pad. Minimum service limit: 2.0 mm. Replace pads when at or below minimum. Inspect rotor surface for glazing, heat spots, and scoring. [Synthetic sample procedure.]

title: Brake rotor resurfacing procedure
content: Resurface rotors when thickness above minimum and surface damage is within resurfacing limits. Verify rotor runout after service. [Synthetic sample procedure.]

title: Ford F-150 front brake pad reference
content: Front brake pad assembly HL3Z-2001-D. Application: Ford F-150 front axle. Pad material specification per OEM bulletin. [Synthetic parts reference.]
